stem: Which sentence can **BEST** follow and support sentence 25?

options.label: A
options.text: I'm trying to persuade my best friend Alisha to try a pair too because I am certain that she would love them.

options.label: B
options.text: You should think about advertising these sandals in some of the sports magazines that kids my age read.

options.label: C
options.text: These sandals are so comfortable that I want to wear them every day, even in the winter when it's cold outside.

options.label: D
options.text: Please consider adding some more fun colors, like red or purple, for people like me, who would gladly purchase more than one pair.
